hacks.label: Same characters
hacks.desc: Allow the same character several times in a team (palettes load correctly).

hacks.label: Quick rematch
hacks.desc: Arcade Versus victory screen: hold Square = same teams again, hold Cross = order / leader select.

hacks.label: Unlock all characters
hacks.desc: All 14 locked characters available (new saves and loaded saves).

hacks.label: Combo damage display
hacks.desc: Shows "NN DMG" (and stun) under the HIT COMBO counter. Adds the row DISPLAY (DAMAGE / STUN / BOTH / OFF) to OPTIONS > GRAPHIC SETTING.

hacks.label: Better practice mode
hacks.desc: Practice menu: Display DMG/STUN, Display Inputs, list position & item rework, COUNTER option fix, faster life recovery, quick reset, gauge MAX+SKILL, guard ALL / random guard, 2P can use the menu, Triangle on COMMAND edits the other side, new key binds COMMAND ENEMY & QUICK RESET

hacks.label: Skip intro logos
hacks.desc: Skips the start-up logos except the SNK Playmore logo (LOGO04).

hacks.label: Version display
hacks.desc: Shows "V1.5" (the Mad Gear version of this build) in red at the bottom right of the main menu.

hacks.label: Main menu clock: no spin
hacks.desc: The clock in the main menu stays still when the cursor moves.

hacks.label: Fix PS2 differences
hacks.desc: PS2 Arcade Mode (DATA/PLA): set characters whose frame data differs from the arcade to arcade values. Yuri: front roll, 6A recovery, 63214K approach, 236A/236C timing, 236236K hitboxes.
